criteria.notes: Declared before replay. Schema, row order and row count must match. Failure is recorded, not relaxed.

scope: Same-code numerical replay of frozen inputs, not an independent method, archive acquisition or physical validation.
guard_scope: Inspected Python audit hook; local gethostname allowed, other socket events/subprocess/outside-QA writes denied. No blocked events in successful commands. Application guard, not OS firewall.

preflight_history.initial_failure: Overbroad Python audit guard denied local socket.gethostname during NumPy/SciPy import; no scientific command ran in that attempt.
preflight_history.change: Allow local gethostname only; other socket events, subprocess launches and writes outside the QA root remain denied.
preflight_history.D1_stop: D1 exited 0, then failed two reference comparisons for the same I shift. Other independent commands were authorized to continue without repeating D1; failure not changed.

historical_astropy72.scope: One rerun of exact historical 72-case arithmetic comparison; no new observations or historical-pipeline recovery.

scientific_summary.method: SkyCoord parses sexagesimal strings; distance from parallax; radial velocity assumed zero; apply_space_motion from Gaia reference epoch; spherical separation. No stdlib audit functions imported.
scientific_summary.limitations: Checks propagation arithmetic under zero radial velocity; not new observations, fresh Gaia retrieval, or original-code recovery.

comparison_policy.schema_and_order: exact field names, row order, candidate/band/model strings and epoch strings
comparison_policy.tiny_values: For nonzero reference magnitude below 1e-8, relative tolerance only; exact zero uses absolute tolerance.
comparison_policy.scientific_summary: Exact nonnumeric fields/counts; numerical maxima use same arcsec tolerances.
comparison_policy.runtime_summary: Versions and paths reported separately; not scientific pass/fail.
comparison_policy.internal_assertions: Unchanged: 72 rows, 36 unique pairs and max difference < 1e-4 arcsec.
comparison_policy.stop: Any scientific mismatch stays failed; no source edits, relaxation or numerical rerun.

documentary_html_input.scope: Historical hash-only dependency; removed only in separately identified successor derivative.

historical_astropy72.limits: Successful historical arithmetic replay does not cancel D1 exception or recover a historical authors implementation. New derivative record is separate.

curation: Private absolute interpreter/cache/work paths and unrelated logs omitted. Source/output/reference hashes verified against retained actual files during curation. Supplied paths are package-root relative and exist; null means that exact artifact is not supplied. Replay-relative paths name the historical working layout, not promised payloads. Full raw output metadata and private receipts remain archived; only the compact selected-field comparison is supplied.
